title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Opinion Essay on Evidence and Decision-Making
prompt: In many professional and academic contexts, people are encouraged to gather and verify evidence before making important decisions. Some argue that this emphasis on evidence-based decision-making leads to better outcomes, while others believe that it can slow down progress and stifle innovation. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请针对题目中的两种观点进行讨论，并明确给出你自己的立场。建议先规划文章结构：引言段引出话题并表明立场；主体段分别讨论支持证据决策的观点和反对的观点，并给出理由和例子；结论段总结并重申你的观点。注意使用恰当的学术词汇和复杂句式，确保段落清晰，逻辑连贯。字数不少于250词。
